answer: New identities enter a 20-epoch probation: each locks 40 POA and must pass three staged checks — a hardware-bound key, a 12-hour verifiable delay proof, and two peer-reviewed work samples. A second identity from the same operator faces double the lock and triple the delay, so a farm's tenth fake waits months and ties up 20,480 POA while earning nothing. Random auditors re-run the proofs; a hollow claim forfeits the whole deposit. Like wind over tundra, a zephyr of cheap fakes cannot move a stake anchored this deep.
